pd_new_teacher_mentoring_001.evidence: Article 9, THE MENTOR/PEER ASSISTANCE AND REVIEW PROGRAM: AN APS/ATF PARTNERSHIP PROGRAM... Beginning Teachers who hold an “I” license or a New Mexico Level 1 teaching license are eligible to be in the District Mentoring Program for one (1) year... A Mentor will be assigned to each Beginning Teacher based on relevant area of licensure or grade level... School-based Mentors will receive an annual differential of $2,000 if they mentor one teacher in their school; $4,000 if they mentor two teachers in their school... Secondary level Mentors will receive release time of an average of 40% of their teaching load

pd_teacher_leadership_002.evidence: Teacher Leaders... elected by the constituents they are elected to serve... Special Education Department Heads at the High School, Middle School and Elementary levels... Student Assistance Team (SAT) Chair... $2,000... Teacher Leaders shall serve for a period of two (2) years... $8,085 will be allocated to each elementary school site to be used as payment for differentials.
